text: [146] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto na sevitabbo katamehi pañcahi kammantaṃ kāreti adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti dīghacārikaṃ avatthānacārikaṃ 3 anuyutto viharati na paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya #1 ma. kuvacani . 2 po. ma. kiñcanaṃ . yu. kiñcana . 3 ma. yu. anavatthacārikaṃ . sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto na sevitabbo . pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo katamehi pañcahi na kammantaṃ kāreti na adhikaraṇaṃ ādiyati na pāmokkhesu bhikkhūsu paṭiviruddho hoti na dīghacārikaṃ avatthānacārikaṃ 1 anuyutto viharati paṭibalo hoti kālena kālaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetuṃ samādapetuṃ samuttejetuṃ sampahaṃsetuṃ imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabboti .
